maps.title: Rsabhadeva · Day 01 · SB 5.5.1 · This Body Is Not Meant for Sense Gratification

nodeData.topic: Day 01 · SB 5.5.1 · This Body Is Not Meant for Sense Gratification
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.1 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj opens the series with Rsabhadeva's first instruction: the human body is not for the sense pleasure animals already enjoy, but for divine austerity that purifies the heart and gives unending happiness. Austerity is not starvation or Hiranyakasipu's self-torture but giving up enjoyment for Krishna's pleasure, and parents and leaders must train others in it. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Rsabhadeva's first instruction to his sons: what the human form is meant for, and what divine austerity brings. Maharaj reads it slowly, word by word.

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 03:35

children.note:
Maharaj says he learned this verse by heart simply by hearing Srila Prabhupada repeat it in his lecture.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:24 (auto-transcript): “i just i learned this look i just while listening to proper is repeating it from this from his class nice so the sub-day said now i am dear this body is not for saints certification this material body It is not for saints' gratification. Nah, I am de-ha.”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 13:24

children.note:
This one verse is enough to explain our suffering: we use the body for sense gratification that scripture does not authorise, against the principle of human civilisation. — “We are suffering because of deviation, deviant.”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:27 (auto-transcript): “In looking at this word, it is sufficient for all of us to understand why we are suffering. You see what? Because we are using the body for... Sains' gratification, which is not authorized in the scripture. Sains' gratification is not approved. So doing it against the…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 14:27

children.note:
A responsible government punishes deviants; rogues flourish only under an irresponsible one. If Pariksit Maharaja were here Kali could not exist; under Yudhisthira rain fell only at night. Now King Vena sits on the post.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:28 (auto-transcript): “deviant citizens are punished by the responsible government. Only if the government is irresponsible that rogues will flourish. Rogues are flourishing because of the government. Parashat Maharaj is not here. If it's Parashat Maharaj is here, Kali cannot exist. When Maharaj…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 15:28

children.note:
Rsabhadeva is about to retire and hand everything to his hundred sons, so it is his duty to train them to be good representatives.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:06 (auto-transcript): “So, he is speaking to his 100 sons. He's about to retire. So, he's handing over. To hand over, one must hand over to responsible children. So he wanted to hand over everything to his children. So it is his duty to train them properly. So there will be good representatives. So…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 18:06

children.topic: Meant for everyone with a body
children.note:
The instruction is not only for a hundred sons but for all of us who have a material body, especially the human form. — “Now the instruction is for all of us.”

🎙 Maharaj at 18:50 (auto-transcript): “Now the instruction is for all of us. Not for only 100 people. It is for everyone. For those of us who have material body. Especially the human form of body. He very intelligently said, Why? Why? Why did he say? Why? Why not for that? Do they buy their sanctification?”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 18:50

children.note:
Maharaj asks why Rsabhadeva puts it this way. Do animals go to school to learn cooking, or build expensive houses for their wives? Sense gratification is already available to them; if humans also live for it, what is the difference?

🎙 Maharaj at 19:07 (auto-transcript): “Why? Why? Why did he say? Why? Why not for that? Do they buy their sanctification? They buy? We, we work very hard for our sanctification. Animals do they work like that for their sanctification? Animals do they have to go to school to learn how to cook nicely?”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 19:07

children.note:
Citing the Gita, when sense gratification becomes the highest aim, people worship it and acquire it by illegal means — Maharaj points to black markets in India and Africa.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:03 (auto-transcript): “Kama upaboga parama That's about Gita When human beings are considering saint's gratification to be the upa boga parama parama upa boga saint gratification is supreme is a deity of worship for those who are on this platform they will acquire this thing through illegal means…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 21:03

children.topic: A dirty heart must be washed
children.note:
Endless anxiety for sense gratification makes the heart very dirty, and dirty things need cleaning. That is why the verse speaks of purification. — “Dirty things have to be washed.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:04 (auto-transcript): “market proper said satyad so did our heart is dirty certification make the heart very dirty dirty so why it has to be purified because it is dirty. Dirty things have to be washed. They need to be clean. What is making the heart dirty? Immeasurable anxiety for sanctification.”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 22:04

children.note:
Rsabhadeva tells his sons not to join those who worship sense pleasure, but to perform transcendental austerity. Hiranyakasipu also did austerity — to kill Prahlada, Brahma and Visnu and become immortal. Maharaj calls it plain ignorance.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:10 (auto-transcript): “So Receptive said, my dear boys, you should not. You should not join these people. Don't. Use this body for what it's meant for. What is that? You should perform austerity. What kind of austerity? Transcendental austerity. Mbapa said, not like Hira Nakashipu. It performs…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 23:10

children.note:
We practise to become pure devotees because the soul was always pure, only covered. But none of us was ever Krishna, so we never become him; even back home we remain jiva, eternally parts of Krishna, while he eternally rules as Isa. — “we still remain jiva”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:20 (auto-transcript): “We are practicing to become pure devotees because the soul has been pure. Naturally pure. but now he's covered with some sanctification so he can be cleaned again but none of us have been Krishna before so he can never be Krishna at any time when we go back to Godhead we…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 24:20

children.topic: Give up enjoyment to please Krishna
children.note:
We seek sense pleasure because we want happiness but do not know what it is. When austerity is done by giving up enjoyment for Krishna's pleasure, one enters unending joy; sense gratification never makes anyone happy.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:12 (auto-transcript): “When Penasys Austerity are performed for Krishna Pritiye, bogatyaga Krishna Prithye when we do with bogatyaga when we perform by giving up sanctification to please Krishna Krishna Prithye then Brahma Sokkyam to Anantam will be promoted to enter into eternal imperishable joy…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 26:12

children.note:
The ant is the busiest creature: Maharaj says it has no eyelids and works around the clock — for a few grains of sugar. We look at it as a useless, unfortunate creature, yet we struggle the same way on a bigger scale. — “so we are more foolish than the ant”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:54 (auto-transcript): “Of all the living entities, Christmas is the most busiest. Christmas is the most busiest. Ant is the most busiest of all the species. Ant. They don't have eyelids. Means they don't sleep. Not sleeping means walking continuously. but what are they working 24 hours for crimes…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 26:54

children.note:
The way to be happy is to purify the senses; nobody has ever been satisfied through sense gratification.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:21 (auto-transcript): “the way to be happy is to purify the senses is it not? purify the senses nobody has ever become satisfied through sanctification otherwise, if it is possible Yayati Maharaj would have been the first class number one devotee Do you not? He had to manage. He traded his old age…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 28:21

children.note:
Had it been possible, King Yayati would have been the first to succeed: he traded his old age for his son's youth and tried to squeeze enjoyment out of it, then gave it back, admitting a big mistake.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:40 (auto-transcript): “Yayati Maharaj would have been the first class number one devotee Do you not? He had to manage. He traded his old age for the youth. And he tried. He tried to squeeze it. Did he succeed? At the end, what did he say? He said, big mistake I made. Okay, take back your things.…”

Eating, sleeping, mating and defending are done by every species, so they make no one special; a hero does what nobody else can. Maharaj teases: I cook my meat with spices, spoon and fork — then go to hospital. Who is more civilised?

🎙 Maharaj at 30:29 (auto-transcript): “It's four basic activities that all living entities say. Is there any entity that's not doing this? Is there any species of life that's not doing this four activities? All species of life are doing this, right? So what is what's special? You are doing and I'm doing. What is…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 30:29

children.note:
Animals that fall sick go to the field and eat grass, paying nothing for tablets. Let us live like human beings instead. — “So let us not compete with the animals, please.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:11 (auto-transcript): “So let us not compete with the animals, please. Let us not compete with the animals. Let us live a human life. Let's live like human beings. Don't eat and go and die in the hospital. Animals, when they get sick, they go to the fields and eat grass. Naturally, they don't pay…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 32:11

children.note:
Maharaj lists devotees who suffer from what hospitals did to them — a godbrother given the wrong blood, a disciple in America who nearly died from the wrong medicine — after paying heavily for it.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:59 (auto-transcript): “Many, many, many people, including devotees, they are suffering from the disease they took to the hospital. It's only Jabra Kishwani having had a problem. the operation he did in Canada many years ago, part of the problem he is suffering right now in the hospital in the…”

children.note:

🎙 Maharaj at 34:29 (auto-transcript): “And we are not listening. The Vedas are already mentioned. In Caliuga, medicine would not work. We are still going to the hospitals. In medicine itself, they are diseases. That's what the scripture said. We are not seeing it every day. It's not happening. Medicine is serving,…”

children.note:

🎙 Maharaj at 35:54 (auto-transcript): “It's austerity. It's austerity. austerity is different from starvation starvation means there is nothing there is nothing austerity means there are so many all the varieties of accessories for sanctification, they're all available but one willingly with proper understanding…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 35:54

In his days of heavy austerity a godbrother brought fine prasada after Maharaj's eating time, uncovering the plate little by little while watching his face. Both laughed; Maharaj declined — not because it was not good, but because he had decided. — “It's austerity, not starvation.”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:24 (auto-transcript): “I visited those days and I was doing heavy austerity. So I visited one temple and a good brother brought prasada and he came to the table. So we were talking. And he said, Prabhu, this is a prasada. I said, oh, the time for my prasada has passed. So I will not take, you know.…”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:09 (auto-transcript): “Devotees who enjoy, not to suffer. Because suffering is not natural. Enjoyment is natural. Suffering is not natural. It is punishment. It is karma. It is karma. 🎙 Maharaj at 41:58 (auto-transcript): “Divine. Austerities will give us divine life. Divine. Sweet life. Perfect life. That's why we should do austerity. To get purified, to attain is divinity. children.topic: Carry the instruction on our heads
children.note:
Let us obey what Rsabhadeva has given us and execute it. Then we will not be frightened by Ekadasi but take it as a happy challenge.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:47 (auto-transcript): “Means what? Let us follow the instruction Recep David has given to us. Let us obey it. We should carry this instruction on our heads. Means to execute it. She will not be frightened by Kadasi. She will be happy. She will be happy. This is a challenge for me to transcend. We…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 43:47

children.note:
Everything is meant for Krishna's pleasure; it is a devotee's only qualification for acting. He asks of every activity: will this please Krishna? If yes, do it; if not, don't. — “If the answer is yes, do it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:40 (auto-transcript): “Divinity will please Krishna. Everything is meant for Krishna's pleasure, for Krishna's satisfaction. A devotee will never do anything if it is not to please Krishna. The qualification for a devotee to do something is that this will please Krishna. That's the only…”

orbit.ref: This Body is NOT Meant for Sense Gratification | SB 5.5.1 | Vrindavan, India | Jun 27, 2024 · 44:40

children.note:
Parents are not training children, and are not attracting wonderful souls in the first place. If you get King Vena as a son, what instruction will change him? To get a son like Prthu Maharaja there is a process.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:48 (auto-transcript): “The parents are not training the children. Yes, the children are not trained. First of all, the parents are not getting wonderful souls to come to us. If you have King Vena as a child, what instruction will you give to him to King King Vena? What instruction? If you get King…”

children.note:

nodeData.topic: Day 02 · SB 5.5.2 · Service to Pure Devotees: Gate to Liberation
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.2 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Service to pure devotees is the doorway to liberation, while association for sense gratification is the door to darkness. Maharaj uses the monkey that chooses the banana and the palmful of water in the desert to show the deceit of material pleasure, and explains the marks of a mahatma. In the questions he warns against offending devotees while they are present and against pretenders in Vaisnava dress. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: This verse contrasts two doors: service to great souls, which leads to liberation, and association with those attached to women and sense pleasure, which leads to darkness. It also lists the marks of a mahatma.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:43 (auto-transcript): “In the desert, what is the most important thing we need in the desert? Water. nodeData.topic: Day 03 · SB 5.5.3 · The Purpose of Earning Money
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.3 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. A devotee weighs every act by whether it pleases guru and Krishna, earns only what is needed, and uses everything in Krishna's service. Maharaj explains that real renunciation is active and deliberate, not lazy: householders can be swamis, Prabhupada wanted all the money for Krishna, and the Gosvamis built temples for others. Association is to be given, not taken, and hearing about Krishna never ends. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 04 · SB 5.5.4 · Intelligent Persons Never Take Another Material Body
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.4 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Rsabhadeva calls the sense gratifier mad: already suffering for past sins, he repeats them and earns another miserable body. Maharaj explains that the human body's one good thing is the chance to escape, that the soul is not really connected to the body, and that liberation begins here for one who acts for Hari. In the questions he says to follow the guru until bhakti becomes sweet, and to drive out false ego by longing for Vrindavan. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 05 · SB 5.5.5 · Fortune Is Purchasing the Ticket Back to Godhead
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.5 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Without inquiry into the self, every achievement — even Brahma's post or a grand temple — is defeat. Real success is becoming, and making, pure devotees. Maharaj shows that every act brings a result, that only devotional service is absolute, and that knowledge from a devotee, received with humility, burns karma. In the questions he treats pride and disobedience through stories of Prataparudra, Siva and Brahma, and puts the holy name first among all yajnas. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: This verse says that as long as one does not inquire into the truth of the self, one stays defeated by ignorance, and a mind absorbed in fruitive work keeps one bound to material bodies.

maps.title: Rsabhadeva · Day 06 · SB 5.5.6 · The Struggle for Existence Is an Illusion

nodeData.topic: Day 06 · SB 5.5.6 · The Struggle for Existence Is an Illusion
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.6 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj shows that working hard to improve our material position only shifts the load from head to shoulder; no scientist or philosopher has the lifetime to understand this world, so we keep going up and down like a lift. Real fortune is meeting a pure devotee, by the combined mercy of guru and Krishna, and the wise expand that fortune by careful, sincere bhakti. In the questions he warns against jumping to rasa without training and explains that 'by chance' means when one becomes fortunate. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Rsabhadeva tells his sons that as long as the soul is covered by ignorance and has no love for Vasudeva, it keeps receiving material bodies.

maps.title: Rsabhadeva · Day 07 · SB 5.5.8 · The Most Difficult Knot to Undo

nodeData.topic: Day 07 · SB 5.5.8 · The Most Difficult Knot to Undo
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.8 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj explains the knot in the heart between man and woman: enjoyment is natural to the soul, but done on the bodily platform it becomes sinful and leaves two empty people beating an empty husk. Marriage done as devotional service — as with Kardama Muni or the parents of Srinivasa Acarya — is not bondage, renunciation is active engagement rather than denial, and only devotees should marry. In the questions he speaks on healthy determination, on spouses supporting each other, and on serving the guru the way the guru wants. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Rsabhadeva names the attraction between male and female as the knot that binds the heart, from which the sense of 'I and mine' spreads to home, land, children and relatives.

nodeData.topic: Day 08 · SB 5.5.9–13 · Material Life Means Suffering
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.9–13 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj shows that only the strong words of a sadhu can slacken the hard knot in the heart, and then walks through Rsabhadeva's concluding instructions: accept an elevated guru, tolerate pleasure and pain, see that even Brahmaloka is miserable and that everything here is done out of fear, see everyone spiritually, forgive, stop identifying with body and home, study scripture and avoid idle talk. In the questions he teaches crying helplessly to Krishna, that knowledge without bhakti is not enough, and not to give up service when devotees feel offended. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 09 · SB 5.5.14 · Guru's Expression of Love for Disciples
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.14 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj explains that a father's or guru's advice is how he expresses love, and that its effect depends on a potent guru and a ripe disciple, so the disciple should follow exactly without speculating. Knowledge is needed only to lead us to bhakti; once love comes, jnana, karma and yoga fall away, but devotional service — butter-soft, steady and undeviating — is both the means and the end and is never given up. In the questions he shows how to keep a timetable when Maya tests us: carry the Bhagavatam everywhere and plan for the negative too. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 10 · SB 5.5.15 · A Guru Should Take Charge of His Disciples
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.15 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj teaches that the Lord's mercy is held by his devotees, so pure devotees ask only for service, and that a father, guru or king must personally and patiently instruct those in his care — 'my guru is very busy' is not a relationship. Preachers should find ways and means to present Krishna consciousness as it is, without dilution, and by taking risks for Krishna become dear to him. In the questions he explains how the guru engages disciples by their propensity, why second-class disciples should simply follow, and when to take instruction from senior disciples. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Rsabhadeva tells every father, guru and king to keep patiently instructing those in his care in devotional service, and never to push them into fruitive work, which would be like leading the blind into a pit.

nodeData.topic: Day 11 · SB 5.5.16 · Knowing Our Own Self-Interest
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.16 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj shows how sense gratification blinds us to our real self-interest, using the drop of honey between the tiger and the alligator, and how it builds a society of envy even among devotees. He urges devotees to space in, measure their progress by whether lust, anger and envy are decreasing, and check their practice as a shopkeeper checks his accounts. In the questions he teaches glorifying without flattering and making devotees feel useful. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 12 · SB 5.5.17–18 · Qualification of Becoming a Guru
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.17–18 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj shows that anyone who leaves people on the path of sense gratification, whether teacher, leader, parent or friend, is not merciful, and that the essence of all advice is to chant and hear. A guru, husband, father or mother must be able to deliver their dependents; Bali's rejection of Sukracarya and the story of Pundarika Vidyanidhi show what real bhakti looks like. Leaders carry heavy reactions unless they truly represent Krishna. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 13 · SB 5.5.19 · What It Means to Have a Spiritual Body
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.19 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj explains Rsabhadeva's statement that his body is spiritual: it looks human but is not material, and calling it inconceivable describes our limits, not his. Krishna takes any form by his own will, as we choose clothes, and his apparently human dealings, as with Cupid and the gopis, are pure morality and purify all who hear them. In the questions he speaks on recognising a real guru and on hearing so that the message enters the heart. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 14 · SB 5.5.20 · Garbhadhana Samskara Is Not Optional
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.20 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Rsabhadeva's sons are 'born of his heart', and Maharaj shows that the purity of the parents' heart, through garbhadhana-samskara, shapes the child. The sons are told to serve Bharata not because he is eldest but because of his spiritual quality, and service to the pure devotee reaches Krishna. Krishna wants devotees to rule; Maharaj rejects any idea that devotees may exploit people, and in the questions explains why a guru's use of collections is not exploitation. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 15 · SB 5.5.21–22 · Only Qualified Brahmanas Can Represent Krishna
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.21–22 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Rsabhadeva's ladder of living beings, from matter to Brahma and Shiva, is given to show the brahmana's place as the head that must guide the ksatriya's hands. Maharaj stresses qualification over birth, condemns the caste system as a distortion of varnashrama, and explains the brahmana's peace, truthfulness, tolerance and self-control. The Lord in turn serves his devotees, and in the questions he explains why mental and spiritual strength rank above physical strength. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 16 · SB 5.5.23 · Save Yourself From Horrible and Demoniac Activities
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.23 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj explains why Rsabhadeva places the qualified brahmana above all: the success of any sacrifice rests on the brahmanas' satisfaction, as Vasistha warned at Dasaratha's yajna, and the true brahmana is a devotee who lives for others. He contrasts this with today's ugra-karma civilization of weapons, lusty industries, taxes and chemical food, and urges a return to simple, natural, Krishna-centred living. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 17 · SB 5.5.24 · Qualifications To Be a Brahmana
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.24 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj explains the eight brahminical qualities and why results of sacrifice depend on the purity of the brahmana, not on birth. The real brahmana, like Jiva Gosvami and Srila Prabhupada, studies scripture to find Krishna and then preaches out of compassion, because lack of Krishna consciousness is the missing link; character, not vast knowledge, makes a preacher. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 18 · SB 5.5.25 · Devotees Work Very Hard for Krishna
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.25 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj explains akincana: pure devotees ask nothing material from Krishna because, having Him, they already have everything. Through the story of Kholaveca Sridhara he shows the devotee's freedom from want and from what people think, and then describes how pure devotees work day and night and willingly take spiritual anxiety and risk to bring others to Krishna. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 19 · SB 5.5.26 · The Fire of Envy
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.26 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj shows how envy burns the envious person from within, with the stories of the Vindhya mountain and Brhaspati, and warns that envy among devotees is the one force that can check Srila Prabhupada's movement. Because the Lord sits in every body as its temple, we should offer respect to all, practise humility by offering obeisances, and, when envied ourselves, tolerate, hide our advancement and keep strong sadhana. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: In this verse Rsabhadeva tells his sons not to envy any being, moving or still, but to respect all, because he dwells within them.

nodeData.topic: Day 20 · SB 5.5.27 · What to Do With All Our Senses
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.27 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj presents this verse as the conclusion of bhakti: every sense and the mind must be engaged in Krishna's service, because the soul is always active and only service purifies the senses and frees us. Since there is no alternative, any activity, even a so-called spiritual one, that does not connect us with Krishna should not be done; in the questions he shows that becoming a devotee is a matter of mercy and fortune, and that devotional activity without the right purpose is not yet bhakti. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: In this verse Rsabhadeva concludes that the real purpose of the mind, words, sight and all the senses is his service, without which no one escapes material entanglement. Srila Prabhupada calls it the conclusion of bhakti.

maps.title: Rsabhadeva · Day 21 · SB 5.5.28 · A Leader Should Not Be an Exploiter

nodeData.topic: Day 21 · SB 5.5.28 · A Leader Should Not Be an Exploiter
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.28 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Rsabhadeva instructs his already-perfect sons only to set an example, showing that a true leader is everyone's well-wisher and trains people before engaging them; without that goodwill a leader becomes an exploiter. Maharaj explains why Bharata was appointed by qualification and why Rsabhadeva disguised himself to be free of all binding wants. In the questions he insists that those who bring people to Krishna consciousness must train and care for them. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 22 · SB 5.5.29–30 · Plan Your Krishna Conscious Life
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.29–30 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Rsabhadeva lives as an avadhuta, deliberately blind, deaf and dumb to the world, because he knows his goal and arranges his life to protect it; Maharaj warns that if we do not plan our Krishna conscious life, Maya will. Tolerating abuse without anger, as Rsabhadeva did, is the practical examination for going back to Godhead, and Maharaj shares his own experiences on harinama. In the questions he explains why such souls are themselves association and why this world is our training ground. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 23 · SB 5.5.31 · How Did Lord Rsabhadeva Look?
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.31 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj dwells on the beauty of Rsabhadeva's form, showing how great souls look different from us and how a pure devotee's natural smile reveals the beauty of the heart. Through the story of Tilottama and Bilvamangala's praise of Krishna's smile, he teaches that the beauty of the heart is more powerful than bodily beauty. In the questions he explains that attraction to Krishna depends on the soul's fortune and sincerity, like iron to a magnet. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 24 · SB 5.5.32–33 · When All Bharata-varsa Was Fragrant
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.32–33 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Rsabhadeva lies down like a python and covers himself in his own waste so that no one will disturb his devotion, yet his body perfumes the land for eighty miles. Maharaj teaches that destiny cannot be cheated, so the intelligent do not fight nature but design their lives to stay Krishna conscious, using every situation instead of losing the goal. In the questions he urges devotees under pressure to stay sincere, pray intensely and decide clearly that they belong to Krishna. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 25 · SB 5.5.34–35 · The Science of Spiritual Cooking
nodeData.note: SB 5.5.34–35 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Rsabhadeva behaves like cows, deer and crows to protect both his devotion and the people from offences, and though every mystic power comes to him he ignores them, absorbed in love for Krishna. Maharaj explains that devotees are peaceful because they are free from material desire, while worldly opulence and endless wants only multiply trouble. He then teaches how to cook for the Lord with purity and full attention, and answers questions on cleanliness, closeness to the guru, respectful address and purifying the mind. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.
